scope: Completed CPU-only scanner-RGB expansion cases 36 through 41, visually inspected on the original GigaTIME output without a spatial shift

reviewed_cases.visual_observation: Sparse kidney nuclei: virtual DAPI is bright over only some outlined nuclei and has broader diffuse patches.
The prostate field contains erythrocyte-rich areas; large bright virtual-DAPI spots do not map consistently to H&E nuclei.
Dense kidney nuclei blend into a diffuse virtual-DAPI region with low nuclear-boundary contrast.
Virtual DAPI is confluent over a densely nucleated prostate region and does not resolve many outlined nuclei.

Virtual DAPI peaks follow most independent nuclear outlines, with no obvious edge shadow in this small field. The 23-channel sheet shows extensive shared morphology; median absolute pairwise spatial Spearman is 0.898 across channels, DAPI/TRITC 0.956 and DAPI/Cy5 0.948. This nuclear technical pass does not establish protein identity or support cell-type evaluation.
Virtual DAPI remains confluent in the prostate gland region, with many H&E nuclei lacking individual fluorescence peaks.

limits: The contact sheets show RGB, DAPI, DAPI/StarDist, CK and CD68. All 23 saved virtual channels for the one new technical pass were reviewed separately at TCGA-E2-A108-01Z-00-DX1_004/all-23-markers.webp. None of these six cases has entered fastPLS training or testing.
